sent:
Amrita —

First, urgent: sproutandstitch.co.uk is returning a 502. Until it’s back, pause any paid or point it to a fast Playproof page (Shopify Canvas draft is fine). Outages kill conversion and your pixel signal, which breaks new‑creative learning.

10‑point teardown (sproutandstitch.example)
1) Above the fold needs proof, not claims: 5‑sec loop of a grass‑stain knee slide or a seam macro under strain; one line “Playproof clothes for real play.” One CTA.
2) Route ads to a Playproof page, not home/shop. One ad, one promise, one page.
3) Keep reassurance, but after the demo: GOTS, same‑day dispatch, free returns as three chips below the hero.
4) “Play Club” code after a delay risks drop‑off. Make discounts instant (auto‑apply in cart) or move to post‑purchase.
5) Add a simple cost‑per‑wear calc near price to anchor value to durability.
6) PDP/cart: add micro‑proof (looped fabric/knee test and stitching close‑up) next to size and CTA.
7) Reviews: surface ones that mention lasting through play. Filter/tag by “durable” and sort to top.
8) Size guide above the fold; sticky add‑to‑cart on scroll.
9) Checkout: repeat Playproof proof as a tiny loop/icon row; keep dispatch/returns visible.
10) Measurement: each ad concept gets its own URL param; track hero CTA clicks → add‑to‑cart → purchase so you can cut by concept, not just audience.

Playproof landing page wireframe (Canvas)
- Hero: 5‑sec demo loop + “Playproof clothes for real play” + size/colour + single CTA.
- Why it lasts: reinforced areas, fabric spec, stitching detail (short copy, big visuals).
- Social proof: reviews that mention durability; UGC tiles of kids in action.
- Value: cost‑per‑wear calc; care/wash note.
- Offer/reassurance: same‑day dispatch, free returns, pay‑later.
- FAQ: sizing, repairs/care, stains.
- Sticky add‑to‑cart; footer with materials and certifications.

Three ad scripts (each ships in at least three variants)
1) Kid‑in‑action (hook: “Prove it in 5 seconds”): knee slide → climb → tumble; overlaid “Playproof”; end frame: product + price + “Shop Playproof”. Variants: angles, tempo, captions.
2) Parent VO (hook: “Lasted all term”/“Fewer wardrobe emergencies”): ripped‑knee problem → reinforced seam close‑up → kid back to play. Variants: VO lines, music, end card.
3) Side‑by‑side test: other trousers vs Playproof under the same scuff; macro on wear pattern; clear end card. Variants: surfaces, duration, label style.

Creative cadence (three‑week rule)
- New concept weekly; at least three variants per concept.
- Anything with three weeks of falling CTR retires; anything still climbing stays.
- Keep a queue so nothing goes dark when you pause losers.

Tracking checks
- Meta pixel + server‑side events deduped; verify ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, Purchase fire from the Playproof page.
- Each ad → its own UTM and its own section on the page to read concept‑level performance.
- Klaviyo: browse/cart abandonment and post‑purchase flows reference Playproof benefit, not generic copy.

7‑day kidswear test plan (Canvas + Meta GEM + Klaviyo Composer)
Day 0‑1: Build the Playproof Canvas page (wireframe above). Add micro‑proof loops.
Day 2: Launch Meta with three creative variants pointing only to this page; let GEM optimise placements.
Day 3: Composer audit of welcome, browse, and cart flows; add a 3‑email “Playproof Proof” sequence (demo → reviews → care/value).
Day 4: Cut any ad variant < account median CTR or weak add‑to‑cart rate; duplicate the winner with a new hook.
Day 5‑7: Expand winners to one adjacent audience; ship one fresh variant; keep all paid pointed to the Playproof page.

If you want the wireframe and scripts as editable docs (Canvas section IDs, copy blocks, and shot lists), reply and I’ll send them.
